subject: Final MAP: Compliance artifacts, SIG/CAIQ clarifications, and DPA/retention milestones
messages:
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@trellisfin.com>, Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@trellisfin.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & initial artifact ask — Trellis Financial

Hi Rajiv / Emily,

Thanks again for spending time with us last week. As discussed, I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the compliance gates you requested — SOC 2 attestation, SIG/CAIQ mapping, and the DPA/retention language that must land before procurement can finalize.

Attached is a living MAP (see redwood-map-trellis-v1.pdf). Key asks from your side: confirm which SIG control families you want treated as "must-haves" vs "nice-to-have", and send any procurement redlines for the DPA. From our side we'll share the SOC 2 summary, a CAIQ/SIG mapping, and a proposed retention table for review.

Proposed close timeline (high level):
- Week 1: SOC 2 summary + CAIQ matrix sent
- Week 2: DPA redline exchange + clarification calls on any open SIG items
- Week 3: Legal signoff and procurement review
- Week 4: Final signatures and kickoff

Are there any immovable dates on your side (quarterly board sign-off, audit window, or procurement blackout)? If not, I'd like to propose final signature target of Jun 20 so we can start onboarding in July.

Next steps: I can send the SOC 2 summary and a CAIQ mapping later today, and Neha will follow to schedule a 30-min working session for SIG clarifications.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-map-trellis-v1.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@trellisfin.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@trellisfin.com>, procurement@trellisfin.com
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 10:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & initial artifact ask — Trellis Financial

Ben — thanks, this is helpful. Two quick clarifications:

1) SOC 2: We need the most recent Type II report (or the SOC letter we require for external vendors). Is the 2025 attestation available? If not, the SOC 2 summary + control narrative will suffice for the working session.
2) SIG/CAIQ: We'll mark the following control families as MUST: Encryption (data-in-transit & at-rest), Access Controls, Data Classification/Retention, Incident Response. The rest are NTD for now.
3) DPA: Procurement will circulate a redline. Please note our legal team needs explicit retention windows for PII and log-level telemetry; we'll push for 365 days for forensic logs.

I've attached a short spreadsheet with our SIG questions to make the working session efficient.

Thanks — Rajiv
Director, Risk & Compliance | Trellis Financial
[Attachment: trellis-sig-questions.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@trellisfin.com>, Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@trellisfin.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & initial artifact ask — Trellis Financial

Rajiv — thanks for the flags, and for the SIG MUST list — that's very helpful. In advance of the working session I've attached: the SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and a draft SIG/CAIQ mapping (sig-caiq-matrix.xlsx).

Quick notes on the items you called out:
- SOC 2: We have a 2025 Type II report; we're happy to share the redacted report under an NDA. The PDF is a digest with control owners and gap notes.
- Encryption: Redwood encrypts customer data at rest using customer-managed KMS where configured (we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault).
- Retention: Our default logs/telemetry retention window is 90 days; customer-managed archives are available for longer retention. For customer-managed retention (PII/logs) we can support retention policies up to 365 days with an enterprise add-on and documented controls.
- Incident response: we operate a 24x7 on-call SRE rotation and maintain a documented IRP; Markus (cc'd) can walk through RTO/RPO expectations during the working session.

Proposed additions to the MAP: a short acceptance checklist (SOC 2 receipt, SIG mapping approval, DPA signed, retention schedule agreed). I'll add those to the MAP and re-upload.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, sig-caiq-matrix.xlsx

Best,
Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@trellisfin.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: DPA redline + retention specifics

Rajiv / Ben — looping in legal. Thanks for the initial redline request. A few internal points we want to surface so procurement understands constraints:

- Encryption & KMS: we can commit to customer-managed KMS for customer keys where the customer provisions the key (standard enterprise offering). We'll include language that Redwood never exports plaintext keys.
- Retention windows: as Ben noted, our platform defaults to 90 days for telemetry; for PII we recommend customer-managed object lifecycle rules in the customer's cloud tenant where possible. We can commit to a 365-day forensic log retention on enterprise contracts with documented access controls, audit logging, and a runbook for deletion.
- eDiscovery & subpoenas: we need to preserve the right to respond to lawful requests and will include a clause describing Redwood's process for handling legal holds.

We'll prepare a tracked DPA redline (Google Doc link below) with two paths: standard (90-day telemetry / 90-day PII window) and enterprise (365-day forensic logs + customer-managed archives). Please flag which path you prefer and share specific procurement redlines.

Doc link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/redwood-dpa-redline-trellis

—Laura
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@trellisfin.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 11:16:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: DPA redline + retention specifics

Laura — this split path approach works for us. Procurement prefers to aim for the enterprise path (365-day forensic logs) but needs explicit cost/commitment for the archive option. Two quick asks before the working session:

1) Can you provide a short one-page acceptance checklist we can share with our procurement and security committees? It should include: SOC 2 receipt, SIG MUST items verified, DPA signed (enterprise path), retention schedule documented, and KMS config confirmed.
2) Is the 2025 Type II report acceptable or do we need the full report? If acceptable, we'll route the paperwork internally faster.

Also, can we schedule the SIG working session next Tue (Jun 15) at 10:00am ET? Emily will lead on the technical checks.

Thanks,
Rajiv
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@trellisfin.com>, Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@trellisfin.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP status & final close target (Jun 20) — next steps

Rajiv / Emily — thanks for the productive working session and for the procurement redline you shared last week. Quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth:

Summary: 
- SOC 2: 2025 Type II report accepted for procurement review (we shared redacted report in the secure folder).
- SIG/CAIQ: MUST control families (Encryption, Access Controls, Data Classification/Retention, IR) validated; Markus confirmed control owners.
- DPA: procurement redline received; Laura uploaded two-path redline (standard vs enterprise) to the Doc. You indicated preference for enterprise path subject to archive pricing.
- Retention: enterprise path provides 365-day forensic log retention and customer-managed archive capability.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Redwood: upload acceptance checklist + updated MAP (Ben) — by EOD Mon, Jun 21.
- Trellis: confirm archive decision and any procurement cost constraints — by Wed, Jun 23.
- Legal: finalize DPA redline and confirm signature approach (DocuSign) — by Jun 25.
- Joint: final sign-off target — Jun 30. (we kept your original Jun 20 target but extended to Jun 30 to accommodate procurement review).

Links & artifacts: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2bTreLLisMap | HubSpot:HS-43219 | DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Envelope/ABC-123-trellis

If that all looks right I'll convert the MAP to the shared folder and we can start the final legal pass. Appreciate the partnership — we're excited to get Trellis onto Dedicated next quarter.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-acceptance-checklist.pdf (PDF, 18KB)]
